questions.question: Genital ulcer disease and doxycycline therapy.

parts.text: List 3 causes of genital ulcers in which doxycycline can be used as a treatment.

parts_raw.text: List 3 causes of genital ulcers in which Doxycycline can be used as a treatment

questions.model_answer: (1) Lymphogranuloma venereum (Chlamydia trachomatis serovars L1–L3) — doxycycline 100 mg BID x 21 days (first line). (2) Syphilis (Treponema pallidum) — doxycycline 100 mg BID x 14 days as the penicillin-allergy alternative. (3) Granuloma inguinale/donovanosis (Klebsiella granulomatis) — doxycycline as an alternative regimen (azithromycin first line).
questions.beyond_mandell: Only LGV is covered in this chapter; the doxycycline options for syphilis and granuloma inguinale rest on CDC STI treatment guidelines.

cohort_answer.text: Syphilis; Chlamydia trachomatis (serovars L1, L2, L3) - lymphogranuloma venereum, first line rx is doxy x21 days; Klebsiella granulomatis (donovanosis/granuloma inguinale): first line is azithro +/- gent, but doxy or Septra x3 wks are alternative regimens

questions.question: State the preferred therapy for the following sexually transmitted infection.
questions.model_answer: a) Azithromycin is the first-line recommended agent (endorsed by US and European guidelines): 1 g PO once weekly, or 500 mg PO daily, for at least 3 weeks and until all lesions have completely epithelialized (relapse occurs if treatment stopped too early). Alternatives: doxycycline 100 mg PO BID; trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP 80/SMX 400) two tablets PO BID; erythromycin 500 mg PO QID (preferred in pregnancy, +/- gentamicin); quinolones. Causative organism is Klebsiella granulomatis. Penicillin is ineffective.
questions.cohort_conflict: The cohort lists doxycycline/TMP-SMX as first-line, but Mandell and current US/European guidelines endorse azithromycin as the first-line recommended agent, with doxycycline and TMP-SMX as historical/alternative options prone to relapse.

cohort_answer.text: AKA granuloma inguinale, organism = Klebsiella granulomatis. Doxycycline 100mg PO BID x21 days OR Septra 1 DS tab PO BID x21 days and all lesions healed. Alternatives: Cipro 750mg PO BID x21 days; Erythromycin 500mg PO QID x21 days; Azithromycin 500mg PO daily or 1g weekly x21 days
